summary: Postinstall and import-time beacon posts host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: The package ships a `beacon.cjs` that fires both from the declared `postinstall` lifecycle script and from the top-level `index.js` on `require()`. It collects host identifiers (hostname, install path, current working directory, Node.js version) and POSTs them as JSON over plain HTTP to the hardcoded bare-IP destination `http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc`. The shipped library surface is a no-op `Proxy` that returns empty functions for any accessed export, so the beacon is the package's only real runtime effect. The package name resembles common Nuxt/i18n namespaces, matching a dependency-confusion / typosquat harvesting shape, and the destination is unrelated to any plausible first-party publisher of a Nuxt i18n integration.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
